set.body: Formal plan: make modules/linalg the single owner of numerical linear algebra contracts and portable reference solvers. Keep shared code JVM/JS-safe. Add optional JVM Breeze support only behind backend adapters, never as a domain-module dependency. Codify this in project docs and AGENTS.md, then implement by extracting solver traits/results into linalg, deleting duplicate eigensolver helpers, and adding backend differential tests.
set.title: Epic: cross-platform linalg solver backends
